notes.title: Temporarily Suspending the "Dusk Survivors" Demo for Exciting Updates
notes.content:
Since the demo's release, we've gathered valuable player feedback. Based on these insights and our playtesting experience, we've developed an updated plan that introduces new mechanics, such as an electricity system and rooftop construction, while refining existing systems, including water zone mechanics and building functionalities.

In this flooded world, we're implementing a power system. Although the main grid is down, survivors can still utilize generators to restore electricity at night and bolster their defenses.

Most buildings are underwater, but their rooftops remain usable platforms—vital remnants of civilization. Players will need to defend these rooftops while maximizing their construction potential.

Zombies now lurk beneath the surface, ready to attack boats that venture too close. We've removed previous area restrictions to facilitate smoother exploration, and players must clear infested waters to secure safe zones.

As dusk falls, zombie attacks become more intense, making robust defenses essential. Our redesigned building system shifts the focus away from boats, greatly enhancing usability.

These comprehensive changes promise to elevate the gameplay experience. Since the current demo no longer reflects these improvements, we've decided to suspend it. We will commence new testing once the updates are ready.

notes.title: Update to Version 0.5.6.7
notes.content:
[b][Bug Fixes][/b]
1. Fixed a bug where zombies lured out by noise, when killed, could cause zombies in danger zones to not be completely eliminated.
2. Fixed a bug where the skull icon would not change color after entering danger zones multiple times.
3. Fixed a bug where team abilities displayed incorrectly due to excessive enhancements.
4. Fixed a bug where buildings would not be attacked during the construction process.
5. Fixed a bug where defense towers or walls were not fully removed after being destroyed by zombies.

notes.title: Update to Version 0.5.6.6
notes.content:
[b][Bug Fixes][/b]
1. Fixed a bug where ship-mounted weapons could not function properly after capsizing in certain situations.

[b][Content Improvements][/b]
1. Added a construction time mechanic: All constructions now require a specific amount of time to complete, and buildings can be attacked by zombies during the construction phase.
2. Added models and animations for drifting survivors.
3. Added a display for maximum labor capacity. Some buildings now require maximum labor instead of just idle labor.

notes.title: Update to Version 0.5.5.6.1
notes.content:
[b][Bug Fixes][/b]
1. Fixed a bug where ships equipped with small cannon weapons could not automatically recover durability after capsizing.
2. Fixed a bug where tutorial panel text overflowed its boundaries, making it hard to read.
3. Fixed a bug where certain building camera obstructions had incorrect transparency.


[b][Content Improvements][/b]
1. Updated the models for some defense towers.

notes.title: Update to Version 0.5.5.6
notes.content:
[b][Bug Fixes][/b]
1. Fixed a bug where enemy distribution in danger zones was overly concentrated.
2. Fixed a bug where the initial camera angle was disordered.
3. Fixed a bug where ships could not properly clear the fog of war.
4. Fixed a bug where labor and supplies icons were missing in some panels.
5. Fixed a bug where certain danger zones could not become safe zones even after all zombies were cleared.
6. Fixed a bug where some drifting survivor icons were displayed incorrectly.

[b][Content Improvements][/b]
1. Added a new beginner tutorial in the latest version.
2. Adjusted the position of the main scene panel by placing the zombie attack warning panel and the countdown timer panel together.
3. In daily events, supplies can now be obtained as rewards.
4. Optimized the construction process for water-based structures such as defense towers and walls.
5. Adjusted the ship repair functionality: The repair function can now be toggled on or off in the ship control panel. Repair speed is related to the ship's repair speed attribute. Removed the previous behavior where ships were continuously repaired as long as survivors with repair abilities were present.
6. Adjusted the ship control panel: Opening the ship control panel now requires holding the spacebar, and releasing the spacebar will close the panel.
7. Changed the boost activation key to the "F" key.
8. Adjusted the area information display: When the camera is zoomed out to the maximum level, area information will now be displayed directly instead of only showing the area the mouse is pointing to.
9. Adjusted zombie behavior in danger zones: Zombies lured out by ships will now return to hiding in the water if the ship capsizes, instead of directly attacking the base.
10. When the ship enters a danger zone, its skull icon will turn orange.

notes.title: Update to Version 0.5.4.5
notes.content:
[b][Bug Fixes][/b]
1. Fixed a bug where incorrect district location calculations caused enemy difficulty to be excessively high in some districts.

[b][Content Improvements][/b]
1. Removed the "time period" element.
2. Added a "supplies" element. Constructing new buildings on the water and recruiting survivors now require consuming "supplies." Supplies can be obtained from various sources, with the most common being the daily production of "supplies" from renovated abandoned buildings.
3. Danger zones now feature a skull icon.

[b][Other Notes][/b]
1. Due to the removal of the "time period" element, the beginner tutorial has been temporarily disabled and will be replaced with an updated version in the future.

notes.title: Update to Version 0.5.3.5
notes.content:
[b][Bug Fixes][/b]
1. Fixed a bug where the attack notification icons for buildings displayed incorrectly at dusk.
2. Fixed a bug where the images and models of some arrow tower buildings were not displayed correctly.
3. Fixed a bug where the team information at the bottom did not refresh when a survivor with special abilities joined.
4. Fixed a bug where the enemy attack information panel incorrectly indicated an enemy attack on the current day, but there was actually no attack.

[b][Content Improvements][/b]
1. Optimized the ship model to reduce the slight camera shake caused by hull vibrations in most cases.
2. Added a demolition feature for water-based structures.
3. Improved the interaction mechanics of the construction panel.

notes.title: Update to Version 0.5.3.4
notes.content:
[b][Bug Fixes][/b]
1. Fixed a bug where the construction menu could not be opened after drifting survivors joined.
2. Fixed some incorrect light sources.

[b][Content Improvements][/b]
1. Added new content to the beginner tutorial.
2. Added a scrollbar to the survivor list in the survivor adjustment panel to address the issue of being unable to view later survivors when there are too many.
3. Added a "Cancel" button to the rotating wall blueprint panel.
4. The stronghold icon appears yellow when it does not reflect on the water's surface.

notes.title: Update to Version 0.5.2.3
notes.content:
[b][Bug Fixes][/b]
1. Fixed a bug where ship-mounted weapons would not become ineffective after the corresponding support building was invaded.

[b][Content Improvements][/b]
1. Adjusted the attack power of ranged zombies to be more balanced.
2. Optimized the construction panel. Previously, the building panel was located at the bottom of the screen; now, it pops up by pressing the "Q" key.
3. Added a feature where a "Confirm" button automatically pops up to return to the main menu after the base is breached.
4. Increased the size of the warning red dot indicating zombie ambushes in danger zones.

notes.title: Update to Version 0.5.1.2
notes.content:
[b]【Bug Fixes】[/b]
1. Fixed the remaining issues related to enemy spawns in danger zones.

[b]【Content Improvements】[/b]
1. Increased the number of starting cities to 7.
2. The tutorial now pops up automatically and can be accessed later via the "?" button in the top-left corner.
3. Added notifications for when buildings are under attack or destroyed.

notes.title: Update to Version 0.5.1.1
notes.content:
Fixed Some Bugs
1. Fixed an issue where the construction panel images were displaying incorrectly.
2. Partially fixed a bug related to enemy spawns in danger zones.
3. Fixed a bug where ballista tower construction was incorrect.
4. Fixed an issue where ballista towers could not attack under certain conditions.

notes.title: Steam Next Fest, here we come!
notes.content:
At this Steam Next Fest, " Dusk Survivors " will be releasing version 0.5.1. We warmly welcome everyone to come and experience it, and we highly value your feedback and suggestions.

At present, "Dusk Survivors" is still under development, and we are fully aware that there are many aspects of the game that need improvement. If you have encountered any negative experiences during gameplay, we sincerely apologize. These issues may stem from bugs, numerical balance, among other factors. This is precisely why we have chosen to participate in this festival—it provides us with a valuable opportunity to gather feedback, which will be instrumental in refining and enhancing the game. Should you come across any problems, we warmly welcome your input.
Feedback method: https://discord.gg/2XHs2kDY6Z


Lastly, we warmly welcome everyone to add our game to your Steam wishlist! We are planning to launch on Steam around mid-year.
